statement.zh: **中国密码史**：chengyu 拆字谜（Character-Splitting Word Puzzles）。拆字谜把汉字拆成偏旁、部件或笔画，再按约定重新组合来隐藏信息。它与藏头诗同属文字隐写传统，区别在于拆字谜操作的是字形结构，而不是诗句位置。
statement.en: **Cnhistory**: Character-Splitting Word Puzzles.It is registered under cryptanalysis.

statement.zh: chengyu 拆字谜的why见来源账本与正文其他节；该条目不以空段充数。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in cryptanalysis, not because of its name.
